description:
A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back.
If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired.
The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order.
The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software.
After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested.
If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ComputerRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ComputerDropped" name="Defective computer brought in"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostAccepted" name="Costs accepted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostRejected" name="Costs rejected"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Drop" name="Defective computer brought in" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Drop"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalc" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Task_SendCost" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Accepted" name="Costs accepted" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Catch_CostAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejected" name="Costs rejected" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Catch_CostRejected"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Drop" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Drop" messageRef="Message_ComputerDropped"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateCost" name="Calculate repair cost"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCost" name="Send repair cost calculation"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_CostDecision" name="Customer decision"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CostAccepted" name="Costs accepted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Accepted" messageRef="Message_CostAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CostRejected" name="Costs rejected">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Rejected" messageRef="Message_CostRejected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Unrepaired" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Order_Split" name="Repair order arbitrary"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HW_Repair_A" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HW_Test_A" name="Test hardware functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SW_Config_A" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SW_Test_A" name="Test software functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SW_Config_B" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SW_Test_B" name="Test software functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HW_Repair_B" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HW_Test_B" name="Test hardware functionality"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Repair_Merge" name="Repair step completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Error_Check" name="Error detected?" default="Flow_NoError"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Repair finished"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Extra_Split" name="Arbitrary further repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HW_Repair_Extra" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HW_Test_Extra" name="Test hardware functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SW_Repair_Extra" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SW_Test_Extra" name="Test software functionality"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Drop" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_CalculateCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CalculateCost" targetRef="Task_SendCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SendCost" targetRef="Gateway_CostDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecision" targetRef="Catch_CostAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecision" targetRef="Catch_CostRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Catch_CostRejected" targetRef="End_Unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Catch_CostAccepted" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Order 1" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="Task_HW_Repair_A"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_HW_Repair_A" targetRef="Task_HW_Test_A"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_HW_Test_A" targetRef="Task_SW_Config_A"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_SW_Config_A" targetRef="Task_SW_Test_A"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SW_Test_A" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Order 2" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="Task_SW_Config_B"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_SW_Config_B" targetRef="Task_SW_Test_B"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SW_Test_B" targetRef="Task_HW_Repair_B"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_HW_Repair_B" targetRef="Task_HW_Test_B"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_HW_Test_B" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Error_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_Error_Check" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Error" name="Error" sourceRef="Gateway_Error_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Extra_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected == true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Extra_Split" targetRef="Task_HW_Repair_Extra"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_HW_Repair_Extra" targetRef="Task_HW_Test_Extra"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_HW_Test_Extra" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_Extra_Split" targetRef="Task_SW_Repair_Extra"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_SW_Repair_Extra" targetRef="Task_SW_Test_Extra"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_SW_Test_Extra" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
